stations.title: His function
stations.text: Lowers a copy of the count, then drops it.

captions: Kasimir takes three springs from the drawer and wants the count to follow.
His function lowers a copy of the count, and the drawer still says twelve.
You pass the real variables by reference, and mark what is only read const.
Now the drawer, the hours and the bench log change for whoever called.
The program changes the right things now. Next, Dorrit wants it to ask her.
